title: Select packaging labels by weight
goal: Use if to handle packages that reach the weight threshold.
summary: The statement in the curly brackets will be executed when the condition of if is true. After the branch executes return, the function ends immediately. Other packages continue to return at the end of the function.
tasks: completes packingLabel(weightKg). The parameter is the non-negative package weight in kilograms.
If the weight reaches 10 kg, the string "reinforced packaging" is returned. Returns "ordinary packaging" below 10 kg.

example.note: printing service gives batch reminder when the number of pages exceeds 20. Exactly 20 pages into the last line of return.

hint: Substitute 10 into the condition and try it. The question says that if it reaches 10 kilograms, a reinforcement label should be attached, and the comparison symbol should include equal to.
